hypothesis: Capacity/optimization fitting diagnostic against the completed narrow feedback arm. Same initial narrow checkpoint, query protocol, aggregated current-policy branch bank, common frozen fit bank, losses, data draws, larger batches, nominal learning rate and2000 updates.
